Title: [LSJ] Repulsion (presence level) and strike: continue action as if unblocked

Messages.Author: Unique Master
Messages.Body:
LSJ,

After playing Repulsion at the presence level and being blocked, if you use
a strike that allows you to continue the action, do you get a manuever to
long from Repulsion if you are blocked again? I'm thinking yes, because
action modifiers stay in effect throughout the entire action.

Repulsion:
[pre]: Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced. If this
action is blocked, the acting vampire gets 1 optional maneuver, only usble
to maneuver to long range, during the resulting combat.

And the strikes (although they are pretty much worded the same):

Form of Mist:
[PRO] Strike: combat ends. If this vampire is acting, he or she may burn 1
blood to continue the action at +1 stealth as if unblocked (this action can
still be blocked). A vampire may play only 1 Form of Mist at superior each
action.

Chameleon's Colors:
[SPI]: Only usable at long range. Strike: combat ends. If this vampire was
blocked while performing an action other than bleeding, the action continues
as if unblocked.

Shadow Body:
[OBT] As above, and if this vampire was blocked while performing an action
other than a political action or bleeding, the action continues as if
unblocked.

Flow Within the Mountain:
[VIS]: Strike: combat ends. If this vampire was blocked while performing an
action, the action continues as if unblocked.

Toreador's Bane:
[mel]: Strike: combat ends, and if this vampire was blocked while performing
an action other than a political action or bleeding, the action continues as
if unblocked. [MEL]: Strike: combat ends, and the action continues as if
unblocked.

continuing on,
Mike Ooi

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 7 Feb 2004 17:48:39 -0600, "Unique Master"
<sh...@removethistexas.net> wrote:

>After playing Repulsion at the presence level and being blocked, if you use
>a strike that allows you to continue the action, do you get a manuever to
>long from Repulsion if you are blocked again? I'm thinking yes, because
>action modifiers stay in effect throughout the entire action.

As long as the combat is triggered by a block, you will have 1
optional maneuver only usable to go to long range.

Your thinking is correct.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

6.2.2 Summary of the Course of an Action

The effect of an action modifier or a reaction card lasts for the
duration of the current action by default.

Carpe noctem.
